parts:
Hello LAVAAN members

Monte Carlo Simulations: Power Analysis and Beyond led by Timothy Bednall (Swinburne University and Deloitte Global) is now available as an on-demand streaming seminar. This workshop on Monte Carlo Simulations offers a comprehensive understanding of applying these powerful techniques to regression, path analysis, and structural equation modeling. For researchers utilizing the lavaan package in R, this seminar provides practical skills to conduct Monte Carlo simulations for power analysis, statistical assumption checking, and method development within their latent variable models. Participants will learn to leverage lavaan to explore complex data structures and enhance the robustness and predictive accuracy of their own structural equation models.

Access this seminar at your own pace and please share this with colleagues and students who might benefit!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Professor and Director
